exposure: maternal oral contraceptive use during breastfeeding
cohort: 200 mother-child couples seen for consultation in an urban health center in Sale city, Morocco.
finding: Artificial breastfeeding, cesarean delivery, and maternal oral contraceptive use during breastfeeding were associated with an increased risk of early adiposity rebound in children.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of early adiposity rebound (OR = 4.7; 95% CI [2.46-9.08]; P-value=0.000).
followup_time: Children's average age was 42.3 +/- 18.9 months at the time of the study.
